name: timesheet
description: Track time and manage projects, tasks, absences, contracts, expenses, todos, and team data in Timesheet

interface.longDescription:
Timesheet is a time tracking service for freelancers and teams. This plugin lets you work with your Timesheet account in the conversation:

- Start, pause, and stop the timer, and see what is running, in the conversation or in the sidebar.
- In Work chats, let ChatGPT act on events, such as a stopped timer or a new time entry.
- Log finished work with its project, times, and description, and correct past entries.
- See your hours by day, week, project, or client, and create Excel, CSV, or PDF exports.
- Manage projects, tags, todos, notes, expenses, and breaks.
- Request time off, and approve or reject absences when you manage a team.
- Manage organizations, teams, members, contracts, and rates.

Sign in with your Timesheet account the first time you use it. The plugin reads and changes only the data your account can access.
defaultPrompt: How many hours did I track this week?
Start a timer for one of my projects
Export last month's hours as a PDF

positive.description: Hours for a past month, broken down by project and client
positive.prompt: How many hours did I track in September 2026, broken down by client?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the total hours for September 1 to 30, 2026 with a breakdown by project and client (Website Redesign for Northwind Traders, Mobile App for Acme Inc., Brand Guidelines for Blue Harbor Studio, Internal), and renders the statistics widget.

positive.description: Start the timer on a named project
positive.prompt: Start a timer for the Website Redesign project.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Website Redesign project and starts the timer on it from now. The timer widget shows the running timer with the project and its client.

positive.description: Stop the running timer (run after the previous case)
positive.expected_behavior: Stops the running timer and saves the time entry on Website Redesign. The widget shows the saved entry with its start time, end time and duration.

positive.description: Log finished work with times and a description
positive.prompt: Log 2 hours on the Mobile App project yesterday from 9:00 to 11:00 for API integration work.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a finished time entry on Mobile App for yesterday from 09:00 to 11:00 in the account's time zone, with the description API integration work, and shows it in the entry card.

positive.description: Export a past month as a PDF
positive.prompt: Export my hours from September 2026 as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a PDF export of the time entries from September 1 to 30, 2026 and returns a download link for the file.

negative.description: Blanket deletion: deleting entries cannot be undone, so the plugin must not delete without specific entries and an explicit confirmation. Expected: it asks which entries to delete and for confirmation, and deletes nothing yet.

Plan change: the plugin has no billing tools and must not start a purchase or upgrade. Expected: it explains that plans cannot be changed in the conversation, at most naming the informational plans page, and calls no tool.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Timesheet subscription to the Business plan.

negative.description: Another person's data: the plugin only reads data the connected account may access. Expected: it explains that it cannot show the time entries of a user outside the account's teams and organization, and shows none.
negative.prompt: Show me the time entries of anna@example.com for last week.

review.commerce_description: Timesheet does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release in the ChatGPT plugin directory: start, pause and stop the timer, log and correct time entries, see hours by project and client, create Excel, CSV and PDF exports, and manage projects, todos, expenses, absences and team data, with interactive widgets for the timer, entries, projects, statistics and exports. The live timer also opens from the sidebar, and in Work chats ChatGPT can act on Timesheet events, such as a stopped timer or a new time entry.

de-DE.subtitle: Zeiterfassung und Projekte
de-DE.description:
Timesheet ist eine Zeiterfassung für Freelancer und Teams. Mit diesem Plugin arbeiten Sie direkt im Chat mit Ihrem Timesheet-Konto:

- Starten, pausieren und stoppen Sie den Timer und sehen Sie, was gerade läuft, im Chat oder in der Seitenleiste.
- Lassen Sie ChatGPT in Work-Chats auf Ereignisse reagieren, etwa auf einen gestoppten Timer oder einen neuen Zeiteintrag.
- Erfassen Sie erledigte Arbeit mit Projekt, Zeiten und Beschreibung und korrigieren Sie frühere Einträge.
- Sehen Sie Ihre Stunden nach Tag, Woche, Projekt oder Kunde und erstellen Sie Exporte als Excel, CSV oder PDF.
- Verwalten Sie Projekte, Stichwörter, To-Dos, Notizen, Auslagen und Pausen.
- Beantragen Sie Urlaub oder andere Abwesenheiten und genehmigen oder lehnen Sie Anträge ab, wenn Sie ein Team leiten.
- Verwalten Sie Organisationen, Teams, Mitglieder, Verträge und Stundensätze.

Melden Sie sich beim ersten Mal mit Ihrem Timesheet-Konto an. Das Plugin liest und ändert nur Daten, auf die Ihr Konto Zugriff hat.

fr-FR.subtitle: Suivi du temps et des projets
fr-FR.description:
Timesheet est un service de suivi du temps pour les freelances et les équipes. Ce plugin vous permet d'utiliser votre compte Timesheet directement dans la conversation.

- Démarrez, mettez en pause et arrêtez le chronomètre, et voyez ce qui est en cours, dans la conversation ou dans la barre latérale.
- Dans les conversations Work, laissez ChatGPT réagir aux événements, comme un chronomètre arrêté ou une nouvelle saisie de temps.
- Enregistrez le travail terminé avec son projet, ses horaires et sa description, et corrigez les saisies passées.
- Consultez vos heures par jour, semaine, projet ou client, et créez des exports Excel, CSV ou PDF.
- Gérez les projets, étiquettes, tâches à faire, notes, dépenses et pauses.
- Demandez des congés ou d'autres absences, et approuvez ou refusez les demandes si vous gérez une équipe.
- Gérez les organisations, équipes, membres, contrats et taux horaires.

Connectez-vous avec votre compte Timesheet lors de la première utilisation. Le plugin lit et modifie uniquement les données auxquelles votre compte a accès.

es-ES.subtitle: Control de horas y proyectos
es-ES.description:
Timesheet es un servicio de control de horas para freelancers y equipos. Con este plugin puedes trabajar con tu cuenta de Timesheet directamente en el chat:

- Inicia, pausa y detén el cronómetro, y consulta qué está en marcha, en el chat o en la barra lateral.
- En los chats de Work, deja que ChatGPT actúe ante eventos, como un cronómetro detenido o un nuevo registro de horas.
- Registra el trabajo terminado con su proyecto, horario y descripción, y corrige registros anteriores.
- Consulta tus horas por día, semana, proyecto o cliente, y crea exportaciones en Excel, CSV o PDF.
- Gestiona proyectos, etiquetas, tareas pendientes, notas, gastos y pausas.
- Solicita vacaciones u otras ausencias, y aprueba o rechaza solicitudes si gestionas un equipo.
- Gestiona organizaciones, equipos, miembros, contratos y tarifas.

Inicia sesión con tu cuenta de Timesheet la primera vez que lo uses. El plugin solo lee y modifica los datos a los que tu cuenta tiene acceso.

pt-BR.subtitle: Controle de horas e projetos
pt-BR.description:
O Timesheet é um serviço de controle de horas para freelancers e equipes. Com este plugin, você usa sua conta do Timesheet diretamente no chat:

- Inicie, pause e pare o cronômetro e veja o que está em andamento, no chat ou na barra lateral.
- Nos chats do Work, deixe o ChatGPT agir com base em eventos, como um cronômetro parado ou um novo registro de horas.
- Registre o trabalho concluído com projeto, horários e descrição, e corrija registros anteriores.
- Veja suas horas por dia, semana, projeto ou cliente e crie exportações em Excel, CSV ou PDF.
- Gerencie projetos, etiquetas, afazeres, notas, despesas e pausas.
- Solicite férias ou outras ausências e aprove ou rejeite solicitações quando gerenciar uma equipe.
- Gerencie organizações, equipes, membros, contratos e valores por hora.

Entre com sua conta do Timesheet na primeira vez que usar. O plugin lê e altera apenas os dados que sua conta pode acessar.

nl-NL.subtitle: Urenregistratie en projecten
nl-NL.description:
Timesheet is een urenregistratiedienst voor freelancers en teams. Met deze plugin werk je direct in de chat met je Timesheet-account:

- Start, pauzeer en stop de timer en zie wat er nu loopt, in de chat of in de zijbalk.
- Laat ChatGPT in Work-chats reageren op gebeurtenissen, zoals een gestopte timer of een nieuwe urenregistratie.
- Registreer afgerond werk met project, tijden en omschrijving, en corrigeer eerdere registraties.
- Bekijk je uren per dag, week, project of klant en maak exports in Excel, CSV of PDF.
- Beheer projecten, tags, to-do's, notities, uitgaven en pauzes.
- Vraag verlof of andere afwezigheid aan en keur aanvragen goed of af als je een team beheert.
- Beheer organisaties, teams, leden, contracten en tarieven.

Log de eerste keer in met je Timesheet-account. De plugin leest en wijzigt alleen gegevens waartoe je account toegang heeft.
